\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]
\footnotesize
\item \textit{Notes:} Each cell is the percentage change in QLIKE of a pooled intraday forecast against its reference, with the Diebold--Mariano statistic of the difference in parentheses (negative: the arm has the lower loss); every bar of Table~\ref{tab:rh_oos} is scored (2014--2024) and the test runs on daily average QLIKE. Panel A removes one predictor group (its series' trailing averages and availability shares) from the full set; Panel B adds one group to the HAR benchmark; Panel C adds the semivariances RS$^{+}$ and RS$^{-}$ of the last half hour (SHAR), the HARQ interaction of realized variance with the square root of realized quarticity, and the negative half-hour returns at every HAR horizon (LHAR), all from the same E-mini one-minute data. Every model keeps the full set's frozen hyperparameters (the linear penalties chosen on the 2013 pre-sample fold for the full set; one configuration per tree method).  The random forest is run for Panel B and for the realized-moment group of Panel A only.  Series that start after the data enter as zero until the rolling window holds 3,000 days of their history (Section~\ref{sec:rh_predictors}), so the implied-volatility, sentiment and volatility-demand rows of Panels A and B measure those series only from the dates in the text. Panel E scores the same forecasts on the bars on which the group's value averages are live (all three StockTwits series from \rhabLiveSentStart{}; the VIX from \rhabLiveIvStart{}; the VIX and VIX3M from \rhabLiveIvbStart{}; the volatility-demand series from \rhabLiveVdStart{} until their feed stops on \rhabLiveVdEnd{}), subsamples of \rhabLiveSentDays{}, \rhabLiveIvDays{}, \rhabLiveIvbDays{} and \rhabLiveVdDays{} trading days.
\end{tablenotes}
